what: The four published probes exactly as the post's scores used them, for Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B at revision fc05daec18b0a78c049392ed2e771dde82bdf654. Layer L is the output of decoder block L (Hugging Face hidden_states[L + 1]). Every published-probe score in the post was computed with these files: each scoring run recorded the sha256 of the files it loaded, and all of them equal the values below. How each probe was obtained or built, and how it scores a unit, is in pipeline/published_probes/.
licenses: NOTICE: all four probes are derived from Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B (Apache-2.0, copy in LICENSE-QWEN-APACHE-2.0.txt); the deception probe is FAR AI's (MIT, deception_probe/LICENSE); the other three are ours (MIT, as this repository).

deception_probe.arrays: per layer: linear.weight float32 [1, 5120], linear.bias [1], input_scale [1], input_mean [1] (0), platt_A [1], platt_B [1] (stored, not applied)
deception_probe.score: mean over the six layers of sigmoid(linear.weight . (x_L / input_scale) + linear.bias); between 0 and 1, higher is more suspicious
deception_probe.origin: FAR AI's published weights (Hollinsworth et al. 2026, arXiv 2610.12445), Hugging Face AlignmentResearch/probe-inference-weights at revision 08942e47fc0dbebee330d51248c7eaa89cfe540e, qwen3.5-27b/linear/layer_<L>/model.pt, converted to safetensors without unpickling; we changed no value
deception_probe.license: MIT, copyright 2026 FAR AI, Inc.; see deception_probe/LICENSE

harmfulness_direction.score: x_34 . direction; higher is more suspicious
harmfulness_direction.origin: built by us: the difference in mean activations between 128 harmful and 128 harmless prompts (andyrdt/refusal_direction at 9d852fae1a9121c78b29142de733cb1340770cc3) at the request's last token, read on an H200 GPU

refusal_direction.score: x_47 . direction; higher is more suspicious
refusal_direction.origin: built by us: the same prompts and difference, at the prompt's last token (just before the model's reply), read on an H200 GPU

high_stakes_probe.arrays: direction float32 [5120] and bias [1] (the folded probe the score uses); W [5120], intercept [1], mean [5120], std [5120] (the logistic regression on standardized activations they fold)
high_stakes_probe.score: x_43 . direction + bias, the log-odds of a high-stakes situation; higher is more suspicious
high_stakes_probe.origin: trained by us: logistic regression on the mean activation over each conversation's content tokens, on the 8,000 training conversations of McKenzie et al. 2025 (Hugging Face dataset Arrrlex/models-under-pressure at revision 940d830f639617752f54fdf2bca0da7e0d856a9e, MIT license)

file_metadata_note: Each file keeps the metadata it was written with, so its sha256 is the one the scoring runs recorded: the layer; for the directions the token position ('inst' is the request's last token, 'post' the prompt's last token), the GPU and the time of the read; for the deception probe its source file, that file's sha256 and the folder of our conversion script.
